item: Release row C fails and names a member the log guard stood aside from; the merge says a paused export member did not complete
summary: Before: a member that raised HeavyPaused was written skipped-paused (my C2) but was in neither list row C fails on and in neither marker table, so row C read satisfied with the member missing and the qualification merge said the member was not found. After: row C carries skipped_paused_members, fails on them and names them; both tables know .skipped-paused.txt. These two files are the qualification lane's: no hunk overlaps its open PR 1440. Red-without tests through the real writer.
